The live Pearson programme page carries NO programme-specific brand mark of its own - the only raster content on it is editorial photography (e.g. 'large-card_0.jpg', campus promo cards). Direct GET returned HTTP 200, Content-Type image/svg+xml, 143192 bytes, root <svg width="162" height="58" viewBox="0 0 162 58">. Note for transparency: the same graphic is also inlined site-wide via <use xlink:href="/themes/utfs/dist/icons.svg#logo-svg">, but the URL proposed here is the standalone SVG file that the page explicitly declares as its logo, not a sprite fragment, and it is a vector asset so the 162x58 nominal size is not a resolution limit.

records.title: World in Serbia Project Scholarships of the Government of the Republic of Serbia

validation.notes: Shard official_source_url is a PDF (WORLD-IN-SERBIA-PROJECT-DESCRIPTION-2026-2027-2028.pdf) on prosveta.gov.rs; nothing extractable from a PDF letterhead without cropping, which the brief forbids. I therefore used the ministry's live official programme page, fetched HTTP 200, title 'Стипендије Свет у Србији - Министарство просвете, науке и технолошког развоја' (Stipendije Svet u Srbiji), h1 'Стипендије Свет у Србији'. IMPORTANT: that page, the ministry home page, and the 2026 competition announcement page (https://prosveta.gov.rs/vesti/konkurs-za-dodelu-stipendija-u-okviru-projekta-svet-u-srbiji/, HTTP 200) expose no 'World in Serbia' project mark at all - the only images on all three pages are the ministry's own logo, a white-on-transparent variant of it, and a lazy-load placeholder. So the correct mark is the awarding body's institutional logo, which is exactly the organisation the record names as official_source: 'Ministry of Education, Science and Technological Development of the Republic of Serbia'. The proposed asset is the ministry's own WordPress custom/site logo (the 'custom-logo' + site-logo elementor slot), https://prosveta.gov.rs/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/Logo-1.png - HTTP 200, image/png, 23772 bytes, 353x96. Rendered and visually confirmed: Serbian state emblem/crest beside 'Република Србија / МИНИСТАРСТВО ПРОСВЕТЕ, НАУКЕ И ТЕХНОЛОШКОГ РАЗВОЈА РЕПУБЛИКЕ СРБИЈЕ' in black. This variant is preferred over .../2022/11/mpn-logo.png (318x96, identical crest but the lettering is white-on-transparent and would render invisible on a light card). Confidence is MEDIUM rather than HIGH for two reasons: (a) it is the administering ministry's mark rather than a 'World in Serbia' programme mark, and (b) the native asset is small (353x96).

records.title: Beca Posgrado STEM Regional (Fulbright-Garcia Robles) - COMEXUS

validation.notes: Shard official_source_url fetched HTTP 200: the live 'Beca Posgrado STEM Regional' page (breadcrumb Inicio > Becas para Mexicanos > Beca Posgrado STEM Regional; body text 'La beca Fulbright-García Robles se otorga a estudiantes con nacionalidad MEXICANA'). COMEXUS publishes its own brand mark at https://www.comexus.org.mx/images/logo-footer.svg - HTTP 200, image/svg+xml, 9140 bytes, root <svg id="Capa_1" ... viewBox="0 0 170.1 56.1">, 44 vector paths, no embedded raster. I rendered it and visually confirmed the official COMEXUS lockup: the two-globe mark with 'FULBRIGHT' in bold, 'COMEXUS' below, and the strapline 'BECAS FULBRIGHT-GARCÍA ROBLES' in brand colours #0056A2 / #0089CF / #00B7F1. This is exactly the identity of this record (COMEXUS administers the Fulbright-García Robles programmes). It is the site's own footer brand logo, proven by the verbatim rule in COMEXUS's own stylesheet: '.logo-footer{ ... background-image: url(/images/logo-footer.svg); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: center; }' (https://www.comexus.org.mx/css/ab_style.css?ids=60), and the page loads that stylesheet. Not a favicon: COMEXUS's favicons live in a separate images/favicon/ directory.
